title: GC advisory lock released before articles-table cleanup creates re-collection window
description: start_gc_scheduler acquires pg_try_advisory_lock, runs run_once (which calls unpin but does not delete the articles row), then releases the lock. A second GC instance that acquires the lock during the delete phase could select the same CID as a candidate and attempt a second unpin. The articles-row deletion must happen while the advisory lock is held.
